title: Are there platforms made specifically for vibecoded games to share and interact with?
author: Cristazio
selftext:
Hi everyone! I’m not a game developer, but lately I’ve been experimenting with what AI tools can help me create without much coding experience.  
(Mind you I’m not trying to say AI vibecoding should replace traditional development, I just wanted to see if I could make some fun projects to share with my friends.) So far, I’ve tried Websim and Rosebud. Both are cool imho. Websim seems great but it's main thing is building websites (I tried building some game stuff with it but I had trouble getting good results. Maybe that was just me), while Rosebud feels closer to what I’m looking for since it lets me make games and share them online.  
Are there any other platforms you’d recommend for AI-assisted game creation that also include things like hosting and sharing features like Rosebud? Thanks!

comments.author: Low-Spell1867
comments.body: Astrocade is one I’ve seen, even has a vibe coded GTA style game it’s pretty cool

comments.author: Thronebornn
comments.body: Check out PlayCanvas and Construct! Both let you build games (with lots of visual/AI friendly tools) and easily share them online. They’re super beginner friendly and pretty fun to experiment with.

comments.author: op_app_pewer
comments.body:
Try my platform, Dreamforge.ai if you’d like:)

I started it because I got irritated by rosebuds lackluster quality :D

A bunch of free credits, and (IMO) highest quality! (And you can get a link to share for a friend to play right away, or export assets, code or zip ready for itch io!)

comments.author: lookguangyu
comments.body:
I recently came across [combos.fun](http://combos.fun) and have been playing around with it.  
They give quite a lot of free tokens to experiment, and I can generate pretty much any type of game + assets directly on the platform.  
It’s surprisingly flexible — from simple story games to more complex stuff. Might be worth checking out if you’re into vibecoding.

comments.author: Mindless_Spend1609
comments.body: tried eggstriker days ago, it's pretty cool
